title: The Harlem Opera House and the Renaissance Ballroom
summary: The Harlem Opera House was a show theatre like the Apollo, while the Renaissance was a dance hall that sometimes held basketball games.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: How about the Harlem Opera House?
That was a theatre, you know. That's like the Apollo Theatre, or the Lafayette Theatre at that time. That theatre had been there for quite a few years.
So there the band would be related to a show.
Well, yeah. I mean, they had shows in there. They had regular shows with chorus girls and so forth, comedians, dancers, bands.
That was a dance hall. Strictly a dance hall. And they used to have basketball games in there sometimes, but mostly it was a dance hall.
